pages.text: $(bold)What it does:$(reset) after rebuilding your body, use the Body Scanner to generate a checkup report - $(reset)free of charge, no energy and no consumables$(reset). It reads your current body data on open and tracks it in real time: a data panel for a modified frame.$(br2)$(bold)On the report:$(reset)$(li)9 slot rows: part name + grafted organ icon/name + $(reset)rejection$(reset) value with a colored bar$(li)bottom summary: n/9 parts grafted, total rejection and an overall rating$(li)gene row: absorbed-gene digest (hover for details)$(li)breakthrough row: shown $(reset)only while a Breakthrough potion is active$(reset), counting down as mm:ss$(li)synergy-set row: appears when >=2 organs share one creature source$(br2)Hover any row to read the full organ stats or the note on the original part.

pages.title: Reading the Report
pages.text: $(bold)Bar colors$(reset) (per-slot and total share the tiers):$(li)<30 green = safe; 30-59 gold-brown = caution$(li)60-99 orange = warning; $(reset)>=100 red = danger$(reset) (capped - near failure)$(br2)$(bold)Bottom rating$(reset): total >=100 Critical / >=60 Warning / >=30 Caution / else Stable.$(br2)$(bold)Synergy sets$(reset): >=2 organs of one creature source -> rejection growth for that source x0.8; $(reset)>=4$(reset) -> +5 compatibility.$(br2)$(bold)Breakthrough$(reset): a Breakthrough potion lets organs of that source exceed the 100 cap while active (mm:ss countdown).$(br2)Rejection mechanics (grafting, cultivation, potions): $(l:akaishi:life_organs)Organ Construction$(/l) and $(l:akaishi:life_potions)Life Potions$(/l).

$(bold)Decay Purifier Tower:$(reset) places a tower that clears the $(reset)decay zones$(reset) left behind by accidents, draining their remaining time at ten times the speed until they vanish.$(br2)$(bold)Parameters:$(reset)$(li)Redstone-energy buffer $(reset)1,000,000$(reset) (each energy upgrade +50% cap)$(li)Burns $(reset)2,000$(reset) redstone energy per working tick$(li)Range: tower to zone center up to $(reset)80 blocks$(reset) (same dimension)$(li)Purify speed: removes 10 zone-ticks per tick (~10x; each speed upgrade +12.5%)$(li)No zone in range or no energy -> $(bold)idles at zero cost$(reset)$(br2)The GUI shows Purifying / Insufficient energy / Idle states plus the number of zones in range. A default 30-hour zone clears in about 3 hours with one base tower kept running.

pages.title: What Decay Zones Are
pages.text: $(bold)Sources:$(reset)$(li)Reactor explosion: Decay V (amplifier 4)$(li)Breaking waste pipes, an Exhausted Fuel Barrel or a Life Activator that still holds exhausted fuel: leaks at tier 1-3 scaled to the contents$(br2)$(bold)Menace:$(reset) a spherical contamination zone with a radius of 5 chunks (80 blocks), lasting $(reset)30 hours$(reset) by default (configurable) and persisting across restarts.$(li)Non-undead entities inside: hit every second with a 1-second Decay effect plus $(reset)2 x tier$(reset) magic damage (tier I 2/s, tier V 10/s)$(li)Undead are immune$(li)Terrain slowly erodes and mobs twist over time (skeletons into wither skeletons, horses into zombie/skeleton horses, villagers into zombie villagers)$(br2)If waiting 30 hours is not an option, place a Purifier Tower beside the zone.

Grafting and cultivation: see Organ Construction; potions and absorbed genes: see Life Potions. The Purifier Tower handles zones left by waste accidents; source control is covered in Waste Neutralization.
